# Install KiddyTube on an Android phone

Sideload build of the latest Flutter app (`polish/flutter-ios-next`, catalog seed **55**).

- **File:** [KiddyTube-flutter-0.1.0.apk](KiddyTube-flutter-0.1.0.apk)
- **Size:** 59 MB
- **Version:** 0.1.0 (version code 1)
- **Package:** `ae.kiddytube.kiddytube`
- **Android:** 7.0 or newer (phone, tablet, or TV)
- **SHA-256:** `819f0091f51fc731f13724cc5f4958c7ae1a743e83484300ecc28b8cb4aa12d8`

Phone page: [index.html](index.html)

## On your phone

1. Open the APK link in Chrome (or download the file from this folder).
2. Open the downloaded file. If Android asks, allow installs from the browser.
3. Tap **Install**, then open **KiddyTube**.

If install fails because an older KiddyTube is already there, uninstall that copy first. This build uses a different signing key than earlier sideload APKs, so Android will not replace them in place.

## Parent PIN

Factory PIN: **2580**.

This is a release build. Kids cannot start a video until that PIN is changed. Open the lock, enter `2580`, set a new 4–8 digit PIN, then play.
